title: Polite Requests and Commands
objective: Ask a server politely for the bill, water or the check, and give simple usted commands.
focus: Polite requests with ¿Puede...? and ¿Me puede...?, and usted commands like tráigame

words.note: If unsure, ask: ¿La propina está incluida?
Mexican word; in other countries it is el pitillo or la pajilla.

words.en: Could you bring me the bill, please?
Can you give me a glass of water?
words.es: ¿Me puede dar un vaso de agua?

words.note: Usted command of traer; add por favor to keep it polite.
Say it when you leave the change as the tip.

speaking: Ask a server for a glass of water and the bill, pay in cash, and tell them to keep the change.
